conbody.p: The Pendo Resource Center provides access to support resources from the Help panel.
The Help panel provides access to support resources.
The following options may be available:

li.p: Help Articles: Article-style help content about MyGeotab features and workflows.
Learning: Training resources and learning content.
Know Issues: Information about known product issues.
Help Articles: Article-style help content about MyGeotab features and workflows.
Learning: Training resources and learning content.
Known Issues: Information about known product issues.
Live Chat: Start a chat with Geotab Support when the option is available for your account.
Send Feedback: Share feedback about the product.
Contact Information: View the support contact information provided by your Partner.
Open a training request: Open a request for training assistance.
Open a support request: Open a request for support assistance.

conbody.p: Open the Help panel by navigating to .
Open the Help panel by clicking the Support icon at the bottom of the main menu.

note.p: The available resources depend on the environment and account eligibility. Options such as Live Chat, Send Feedback, Contact Information, Open a training request, and Open a support request may also be available in the Help panel.
